sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule distinctly trilobate and narrowing anteriorly; in the congeneric A. deodarae the head capsule does not narrow anteriorly, being only distinctly elongated at the middle towards the pronotum. Pronotum from transversely trapezoidal to almost oval; that of A. deodarae is distinctly hexagonal with elongated lateral margins.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule distinctly trilobate, narrowing anteriorly. Left mandible with 3 distinct marginal teeth, of which the second is markedly projecting and acutely triangular, not flat-lying as in the new species; right mandible with a notch visible only on the second marginal tooth, and the outline of that tooth is sharper and more clearly defined. Judging from the figure, the pronotum ranges from transversely trapezoidal to almost oval. Measurements (mm; Table 5, values measured by Ahmad 1955, parenthetical values are means): head length including mandibles 6.37—7.00 (6.89); head length excluding mandibles 3.85—4.06 (3.94); head width 3.57—3.85 (3.69); postmentum (gulamentum) length 2.52—2.94 (2.79); postmentum width 1.05—1.12 (1.10); pronotum length 1.47—1.54 (1.49); pronotum width 2.38—2.66 (2.51).

note: Adapted from the interspecific comparison in Беляева (2004), original in Russian; in that paper this species appears as the comparison object for the new species Archotermopsis kuznetzovi, and only soldier characters and measurements are given; the measurements are taken from the Ahmad (1955) column of Table 5 (the comparison values for Holmgren 1913 and A. deodarae listed in the same table are not recorded); figure numbers (Figs 16—19, 26) and localities are not translated; no species-level description of other castes of this species was found in that paper.
